entries.subject: Disc-resolved images or interferometric imaging of WASP-18
entries.finding: The disc is about 0.1 mas across at 123 pc; no image exists. The sphere carries its Gaia color and a model limb.
entries.revisitWhen: A reconstructed image of the star's surface is published.

entries.subject: The spin axis of WASP-18
entries.finding: Not measured in three dimensions in the sources used here; the display axis is celestial north.
entries.revisitWhen: A paper measures the stellar inclination and obliquity.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,432 K and log g 4.37 (u1 0.357, u2 0.312): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-18.json: 4.372.
